model.source: market_uncertainty_v1 sv_prototype Target, P=1 intercept, K=0 flow (WP84 target, unchanged)
model.priors: WP84 ILLUSTRATIVE_PRIORS: mu~N(2 log 0.005,1), log_sigma~N(log 0.2,0.5), beta~N(0,0.002), z~N(0,1)

datasets.sim: models/data-sim.json = WP84 models/data.json byte-identical (simulate.py seed 84084, 1,100 returns + truth h)
datasets.real: models/data-real.json: 682 BTC-PERPETUAL 30-minute bar-close log returns reconstructed by real_data.py from the 72 overlapping rolling windows in STUDIES/market_uncertainty_v1/artifacts/sv-historical-rolling-v1/evidence.zip (September development acquisition); same priors and scale as sim (sd 0.0029 vs prior centre 0.005, no rescaling); bar-close, not midpoint (the only archived midpoint series has 24 rows); N=250 only (682 < 1,100)

quantities.h_next: mu + rho (h_last - mu) + exp(log_sigma) eps, eps[c,j] = default_rng(eps_seed_base+tick).normal(size=(4,20000))[c,j] (chain index c of the arm or reference)
reported: arm's own quantile MCSE (arviz) of P50/P95 relative

reference.arm: oWALNUTS defaults 4 x 2000/20000 per tick, best-of-16 starts, Limits::admit_worst_case + Limits::max_result_bytes_unchecked(2 GiB) (both N; no thinning)
reference.gate: drop chains named by a WarmupStep or SampledLogDensity chain warning; pass iff >= min_chains remain AND rank R-hat(h_next) over the remaining chains <= max_rhat (arviz 0.23.4)
reference.seed_rule: attempt a at tick t: seed_base*1000 + t + 200*a; attempt 1 only when attempt 0 fails the gate (part of the cell definition, not a rerun)
reference.gate_failed: a tick failing both attempts is unscored and counts as a FAILED tick for every arm scored there
reference.mcse_expectation: WP84 posthoc floor: relative MCSE of P50 0.08 % median / 0.29 % worst, P95 0.20 % / 0.34 %, with 4 x 20,000 gated draws; 3 chains raise it by sqrt(4/3)

arms.warm: LIBRARY path: tick-0 default fit 4x1000/1000 (seed = arm seed; reported, outside latency), chain gate on the tick-0 fit (flagged chains dropped from Posterior::warm_state(); < 2 remaining = cell failed), then per tick WarmState::extend_to(3+n, 0.0, 1.0) and Sampler::run_warm with draws(K), seed = seed*1000003 + 16*tick (chain c on seed+c, the WP84 chain seeds), threads 4, Limits::admit_worst_case; the result's warm_state() is the next state; no re-adaptation
arms.refit: oWALNUTS defaults 4x1000/1000, best-of-16 starts, seed = seed*1000+tick; reported as-sampled AND gated (chains named by WarmupStep/SampledLogDensity dropped; < 2 remaining = failed tick)
arms.cmdstan: CmdStan 2.39.0 defaults via cmdstanpy 1.3.0, 4 parallel chains, seed = seed*1000+tick (as sampled; stuck census reported)
arms.nutpie: nutpie 0.16.8 defaults, cores=4, seed = seed*1000+tick (as sampled; stuck census reported)
arms.pyextra: owalnuts.sample_warm (Python wheel built on the box from this branch) on a C-ABI translation of the same density (models/sv_cabi.c, from_cfunc, threads 4), one seed, sim N=250, K=200, 100 ticks; tick-0 via owalnuts.sample defaults; reported only (latency and accuracy vs the same reference)

seeds.fresh: 880101-880103, 889450, 890200, 889500 grep-verified unused before the freeze; 84084 reused on purpose (same WP84 series)

latency.definition: wall per tick from new-target construction (Sv::new / extend_to / data dict) to draws in memory (Posterior returned, warm_state taken); draw file writing and quantile computation excluded; Stan arms include data JSON, process spawn and CSV read (CmdStan) or with_data (nutpie); compilation excluded

accuracy.rule: a scored tick passes iff |P50 sigma_next rel. error| <= 0.02 AND |P95 rel. error| <= 0.05 vs the gated reference AND no stuck chain AND wall < threshold
accuracy.stuck_chain: a chain is stuck when the median of its log_sigma draws is > 1.0 from the gated reference's median log_sigma, or the median of its h_last draws > 2.0 from the reference's median h_last (WP84 posthoc census rule; applied to every arm, oWALNUTS flags also recorded)
accuracy.scored_ticks: reference ticks >= 1 within the arm's tick range (warm: 100 at sim-N250, 50 at real-N250, 12 at sim-N1000 per seed; refits: 20 / 10 / 4 per seed); tick 0 of the warm arm scored separately (full fit, reported)
accuracy.pass: an arm passes at (K, dataset, N) iff the passing share is >= 0.95 over the three seeds pooled AND >= 0.90 in every seed AND drift is within bound in every seed; integer form: sim-N250 >= 285/300 and >= 90/100; real-N250 >= 143/150 and >= 45/50; sim-N1000 >= 35/36 and >= 11/12

drift.statistic: per seed: mean signed P50 relative error over late scored ticks (tick >= 70) minus over early scored ticks (1 <= tick <= 30)
drift.windows: sim-N250 30 early / 31 late ticks; real-N250 15 / 16; sim-N1000 5 / 4
drift.noise_note: with a per-tick P50 error sd of about 0.9 % (K=200) to 1.8 % (K=50) the statistic's sd is ~0.23 % (sim-N250), ~0.33 % (real), ~0.6 % (sim-N1000) at K=200, so the N=1000 drift test is underpowered: a miss there without a common sign across seeds is reported as noise-compatible but still counts against the pass

decision_rule: The README may say 'real-time quote refresh at K = k' only for a K that passes on all seeds, both N (sim-N250, sim-N1000) and every dataset run (sim, real). Otherwise it states the measured latency, accuracy and the largest tolerance met (over the grid P50 in {1,2,5,10} % x P95 in {2,5,10,20} %) per K, N and dataset.

predictions.P1: sim-N250: K=200 passes (pooled >= 95 %, every seed >= 90 %, drift within 0.5 % on 3/3); K=50 fails (pooled 70-80 %); K=100 fails narrowly (85-95 % pooled)
predictions.P2: sim-N1000: no K passes. K=200 median latency 0.5-1.2 s with < 2 s on 65-90 % of ticks (fails on latency); K=100 median 0.3-0.6 s, < 2 s on 85-97 %, accuracy 85-95 %; K=50 under 2 s on >= 97 % but accuracy 70-80 %
predictions.P3: real-N250: same ordering as sim; K=200 passes with a smaller margin (92-98 % pooled) or fails on one seed; K=50 fails; stuck-chain ticks in the refit baselines more frequent than on sim
predictions.P4: latency medians (4 pinned cores): sim-N250 K=50 15-30 ms, K=100 30-60 ms, K=200 60-120 ms; sim-N1000 4-10x those; the 0.1 s share at sim-N250 >= 0.95 for K=50/100 and 0.3-0.8 for K=200
predictions.P5: reference gate: 1-5 of the 165 reference ticks drop a flagged chain; 0-2 need the second seed; 0 fail both
predictions.P6: refit baselines (20 ticks x 3 seeds per dataset/N): stuck-chain ticks oWALNUTS 2-8/60, CmdStan 4-12/60, nutpie 0-1/60 at sim-N250; as-sampled accuracy share nutpie >= 95 %, oWALNUTS and CmdStan 85-95 % (gated oWALNUTS >= 95 %); none under 0.4 s at N=250; nutpie median 1-1.5 s (N=250) / 4-6 s (N=1000)
predictions.P7: Python sample_warm path at sim-N250 K=200: median latency 1.0-2.0x the Rust warm200 cell of the same seed (70-200 ms), accuracy share within 5 points of it
predictions.P8: bit-identity: run_warm reproduces the WP84 harness construction bit-for-bit on the SV target for tick 1 (all 4 chains)

budget: about 255 lane-minutes: references 42 (sim-N250, 101 ticks) + 20 (real, 51 ticks) + 45-50 (sim-N1000, 13 ticks at ~200 s); warm 27 cells ~20; oWALNUTS refits ~30; CmdStan ~90; nutpie ~8; pyextra ~3; builds ~6. Three queues of 80-95 min each; about 1.5 h wall. Based on WP84 walls on the same box.
execution: lanes 2-4 (cores 4-7 = queue A, 8-11 = queue B, 12-15 = queue C) of the shared c7a.4xlarge, taskset-pinned, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, co-tenanted with lane 1 (WP89) and with each other: walls are 'pinned, co-tenanted'; accuracy and gradient counts unaffected
discipline: three queues run in parallel, cells sequential within a queue in this order; a started cell is never rerun; failures are results; the reference's second attempt is part of the cell
